custom_logic_notes: StDev expansion filter acts as volatility gate - entry signals from ColorXvaMA_Digit are only acted upon when the standard deviation of price exceeds KstDev * iStdDev, meaning the EA filters out signals in low-volatility conditions. The ColorXvaMA_Digit indicator provides color-coded trend direction via two buffers: buffer 0 for uptrend signals, buffer 1 for downtrend signals. Signal reversal logic: opposite signal both closes existing position AND opens new reverse position if the StDev filter permits.
python_conversion_notes: Must replicate or import the ColorXvaMA_Digit algorithm - it is a custom variable-period moving average with digit rounding mode. The StDev filter is replicable with numpy.std on a rolling window. Pay close attention to the digit adjustment logic: SL/TP/Trailing values must be multiplied by 10 for 5-digit/3-digit symbols. The MMType conditional logic (negative=fixed lots, positive=risk fraction) must be preserved. New bar detection must be implemented to ensure once-per-bar signal evaluation. The position gate checks for any open position before entry, not just same-direction.
